name: Audit endpoint access controls
description: A 'security_audit' task: audit all API endpoints for missing or incorrect access control decorators.
prompt: Audit all public API endpoints in backend/app/routers/ for access control. Flag any handler that: (1) is missing @require_project_access or @require_role, (2) uses weak auth only (get_current_user_optional where get_current_user is appropriate), (3) leaks internal IDs or stack traces in error responses. List severity, file:line, and remediation for each finding. Do NOT implement fixes.
